usage: policy for webhooks directing to URLs with suspicious VT reputation
name: Webhook URLs must not have suspicious reputation
description: A webhook URL should not be suspicious based on Virus Total reputation.
detailedDescription: A suspicious destination webhook URL may have been planted during a breach to gain visibility in changes to your code and environments.

args.label: Reputation
